text: One coconut, two foods. Which part packs the calories?
Its water: about forty calories. Its meat: about fourteen hundred!
Per hundred grams, coconut water is ninety-five percent water: just nineteen calories.
The meat is only half water, and a third of it is fat: three hundred fifty-four.
So one small piece, forty-five grams, is about one sixty:
as much as three and a half glasses of coconut water.
